To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we present the framework of Shuffle, an active load balancer for publish/subscribe broker networks; 2) Shuffle features four active workload management schemes for the four types of load in a pub/sub service; and 3) Shuffle leverages Chord to build a suite of overlay trees for workload aggregation and distribution.

Shuffle is the first pub/sub broker network to feature optimal load balancing upon any input traffic pattern, and it is the only pub/sub broker network that can achieve this optimality with a single overlay topology.
Shuffle achieves the optimal load balancing among all possible load balancing algorithms for the workload management problem in a publish/ subscribe service.
